phase: RQ2 Phase 1: dataset, inventory, availability and split manifest

exclusion_reasons.demo: demonstration units, not installed at a stop (decision D6)
exclusion_reasons.show: show unit, not installed at a stop (decision D6)
exclusion_reasons.buspas: vendor's own units, not a transit agency (decision D7)

device_rule.definition: a device is eligible for a window when it reports input power in at least MIN_HOURS grid hours of that window
device_rule.eligible_rq2: eligibility in all four windows (fit / calibrate / develop / test)
device_rule.eligible_rq1_comparable: eligibility in fit + Aug-Oct test only (same rule as rq1.py MIN_HOURS = 168; reported for comparison)

protocol_relation: develop + test together = protocol's [splits.development].evaluate window [2026-08-01, 2026-10-07]; RQ2 keeps August for tuning and scores Sep-Oct last.
leakage_guards: Splits are pure functions of UTC timestamp; no future data crosses a boundary.
Availability is measured, never invented: an unavailable node stays NaN and is reported as 'unavailable', so no detector silently reads a zero residual.
rq_common.load(before=...) is available so hardware and peer columns cannot see later months if a future guard is needed.
The manifest records the previous exposure of the test months (decision D1: the 2 Nov 2026 pilot and two prior RQ1 runs already scored Aug-Oct).
